qualitative.gate_2_reason: Discretionary retail shopping center landlord; consumer footfall and tenant sales are deferrable non-essential cyclicals facing ongoing secular e-commerce substitution.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 2 (G2 Essential Need). European regional shopping center REIT. Mall shopping is a discretionary, deferrable consumer activity exposed to economic downturns and long-term secular disintermediation from e-commerce.
qualitative.evidence: Klépierre owns ~70 prime shopping centers across continental Europe (France, Italy, Spain). Tenant retail mix is heavily weighted toward fashion, apparel, and specialty discretionary goods. Mall footfall and tenant retail sales are cyclical and easily curtailed during economic stress, lacking the essential daily necessity standard required for Munger quality.
